description: The Microsoft security baselines the image gets, applied at first boot in this order (later wins), before config/baseline-overrides.* and the kit's own policies. Each id is a folder here with one file, source.json: the pins of Microsoft's official zip. The settings themselves are not in the repository: scripts/Get-Baselines.py downloads and imports them into the work folder (docs/reference/SECURITY-BASELINE.md).
